rules.typical: Median reading for the zone, day type (Mon–Sun or holiday) and hour over 2019, the year the model was trained on

rules.weather_shift: Rain and solar radiation are taken from the next Open-Meteo hour, because Open-Meteo labels them at the end of the hour and the training data at the start
